description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's second ability by tapping Squee, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat two additional times.
Activate Runaway Steam-Kin by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
